helpfulness.evidence: Imagine you have a program that needs to perform two tasks: one that reads data from a file and another that writes data to a database. If you use processes, each task would run in its own process, and they would communicate through inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms. If you use threads, both tasks would run within the same process, and they would share the same memory space, making communication and data sharing more straightforward.
